status: written after round 1's results and diagnosis (analysis/reports/q2_dirsig_dev.md, analysis/results/q2_v3/dirsig_diag_dev.json), before any round-2 number was computed; dev split only; no test split read; no kernel change

diagnosis_that_drives_it.mass_points: when the child has >= 20% of rows on one value, every round-1 signal is confidently wrong (semantic: D4 0.04, D5a 0.24 on 800 links)
diagnosis_that_drives_it.other_parents: single-parent children: D10 0.77 / D5a 0.70 (semantic); 4+ parents: about 0.5
diagnosis_that_drives_it.where_assumptions_hold: one true parent and no child mass point: semantic D10 0.91, D5a 0.85 (215 links); formula 0.78 / 0.78 (228)

class_fixes.gate: a pair is declined when either end has >= 1% of its rows on one value (observable from data; threshold from round 1's 'none' bin, dev)
class_fixes.conditional: C5a / C6 / C5b (kernel/asym_cond.py): each end's other ledger neighbours, minus its committed children, at most 6 chosen by largest |correlation| with that end, enter an additive spline regression with the pair
class_fixes.mass_side: D14: the end with a mass point (>= 20%) is the child when the other end has none (< 1%); measured only

licence_rule: unchanged from round 1: bar 0.80, threshold chosen on 4 of 5 scenario folds and measured on the 5th, licence if cross-fitted accuracy >= 0.80 at >= 10% yield, where yield is over ALL left-open true links of the regime-D ledger (not only gated ones), so a gate cannot buy accuracy by shrinking the denominator

predictions.P2-1: Gating raises every round-1 signal's full-yield accuracy on true found links, both families, regime D. Refuted if any signal is lower gated than ungated by more than 0.02.
predictions.P2-2: In semantic D at least one gated signal (round 1 or conditional) earns a licence. Refuted if none does.
predictions.P2-3: In formula D no signal earns a licence (its clean subset was 0.78). Refuted if one does.
predictions.P2-4: Conditioning helps where it should: on gated true links whose child has >= 2 true parents, C5a beats D5a by >= 0.03 in both families. Refuted if not in either.
predictions.P2-5: Mass side (D14): on true found links with exactly one end >= 20% mass point and the other < 1%, the mass-point end is the child in >= 75% of links in both families. Even if supported, D14 is not a licence until it holds on a family not generated by CausalArena's compiler.
predictions.P2-6: Gate reach: the gate keeps 25-45% of semantic true found links and 65-90% of formula's. Refuted outside these ranges.

failure_modes_named_in_advance: The gate removes discrete and categorical columns entirely, so D10's strength on discrete pairs is lost by construction; yield may fall below 10% for every signal.
Conditioning sets come from the ledger: false neighbours (shadows) and undetected children in open links enter the regression; conditioning on a child biases the residual.
Six neighbours chosen by correlation may leave out a weak true parent (the misses are weak links by definition).
Mass points at roots (Bernoulli, categorical, zero-inflated roots) make D14 point the wrong way: a sampled root with a mass point looks like a clamped child.

The gate threshold (1%) was read off round 1's dev diagnosis; the cross-fitted licence rule guards the threshold on |score|, not the gate. Any licence here is a dev result to be confirmed on a family with an unread split before it is acted on held out.
